info.title: Optimizely Flags Scheduling API
info.description:
This page documents how to use Optimizely Flags Scheduling API. These APIs allow you to turn a flag on/off, turn a 
rule on/off, change the traffic allocation of a rule and change the audience conditions of a rule.

ActionValue.title: ActionValue
ActionValue.description:
The value of a schedule action.

For status change, value can be on/off. 

For changing traffic percentage, value should be integer. For example, for 40% traffic, value should be 4000.
